description: India business and economy numbers with sources from the productgrowth.in Numbers page: UPI volumes and value, card spends, mutual fund AUM, inflation, internet users and similar (about 110 headline figures). Each figure comes with its source, source link, "as of" date and when it was last verified. If a figure is not among them (for example GST collections), the answer names the Numbers page that has it instead of guessing. Use it when you need a citable Indian figure. Free, no key.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "upi transactions" or "credit card spends".
